brief: Write three static Meta ad copy variants for a parent considering childproofing but unsure how to get started with installation. Use the available support claim without inventing ease, tools, compatibility or installation time.

variants.primary_text: Starting childproofing can bring up a practical question: how do these pieces get installed? The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit comes with 1-to-1 installation video support, so you can get guidance as you work with its edge and corner protectors, socket guards, cabinet/fridge locks and door guards. Listed at ₹3,299, with ₹299 savings on prepaid orders. Childproofing does not replace adult supervision.
variants.headline: Child Safety Kit with Installation Video Support
